chunks: And Ḥarīz ibn ʿAbdillāh narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I asked Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a bondwoman who is married to a slave man and then she is freed. He said: “She is given the choice; if she wishes, she remains with her husband, and if she wishes, she separates.”

key_terms.تُعْتَقُ: she is emancipated or set free

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a bondwoman married to a slave is later freed?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a bondwoman married to a slave who is later freed. After gaining freedom, she has the option either to remain in the marriage or to separate, indicating her recognized legal choice in that circumstance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4873 - Ḥariz ibn ʿAbdillah narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about a bondwoman who was married to a slave man and then she was freed.
Imam (as) said: "She has the choice; if she wishes, she may remain with her husband, and if she wishes, she may separate from him."
